### Program overview
- **Credential:** Bachelor of Science  
- **Duration:** Four years  
- **Study mode:** Full-time  
- **Delivery:** In person  
- **Locations:** Burnaby Campus and UBC Vancouver  
- **Institutions:** Joint UBC/BCIT program  
- **Status:** Active  
- **Completion requirement:** 132 credits  

### Curriculum highlights

**Year 1 – UBC**
- Required: **BIOL 112 — UBC-BIOL-112 — Biology of the Cell**
- Required: **CHEM 123 — UBC-CHEM-123 — UBC-CHEM-111 — UBC-CHEM-121 — UBC-CHEM-141 — Principles of Chemistry 2**
- Required: **SCIE 113 — UBC-SCIE-113 — First-Year Seminar in Science**
- Chemistry alternative: **CHEM 121 — Principles of Chemistry**, **CHEM 111 — Principles of Chemistry**, or **CHEM 141 — Principles of Chemistry**, together with **CHEM 123 — Principles of Chemistry 2**
- Data science alternative: **DSCI 100 — UBC-DSCI-100 — Introduction to Data Science** or **CPSC 103 — UBC-CPSC-103 — Introduction to Systematic Program Design**
- Calculus alternative: **MATH 100 — UBC-MATH-100 — UBC-MATH-102 — UBC-MATH-104 — Differential Calculus**, **MATH 102 — Differential Calculus**, or **MATH 104 — Differential Calculus**

**Year 2 – BCIT**
- **COMM 7200 — Report Writing and Workplace Communication for Forensic Investigation**
- **FSCT 7320 — Introduction to Forensic Science**
- **LIBS 7020 — Bioethics**

**Year 2 – UBC**
- Required: **BIOC 203 — UBC-BIOC-203 — Fundamentals of Biochemistry**
- **BIOL 200 — UBC-BIOL-200 — Fundamentals of Cell Biology**
- **BIOL 234 — UBC-BIOL-234 — Fundamentals of Genetics**
- **CHEM 203 — UBC-CHEM-203 — Introduction to UBC-CHEM-213 — Organic Chemistry**
- **CHEM 211 — UBC-CHEM-211 — Introduction to Chemical Analysis**
- **CHEM 213 — Organic Chemistry**
- **CHEM 245 — UBC-CHEM-245 — Intermediate Organic Chemistry Lab**
- Computing/statistics alternative: **STAT 201 — UBC-STAT-201 — Statistical Inference for Data Science** or **CPSC 203 — UBC-CPSC-203 — Programming, Problem Solving, and Algorithms**

**Year 3 – BCIT**
- **FSCT 8150 — Forensic Biology: DNA Typing Theory**
- **FSCT 8155 — Forensic Biology: Evidence Recovery**
- **FSCT 8370 — Quality Assurance for Forensic Science**
- **FSCT 8371 — Business Management for Forensic Science**
- Elective pool includes **FSCT 7310 — Crime and Incident Scene Investigation**, **FSCT 7910 — Research Methodology and Measurement Models**, **FSCT 8230 — The Medicolegal Aspects of Alcohol**, **FSCT 8240 — Forensic Toxicology**, and **FSCT 8320 — The Science of Fingerprints - Theory**

**Year 3 – UBC**
- **BIOC 301 — UBC-BIOC-301 — Biochemistry Laboratory**
- **BIOC 303 — UBC-BIOC-303 — Molecular Biochemistry**
- **BIOL 335 — UBC-BIOL-335 — Molecular Genetics**

**Year 4 – BCIT**
- **FSCT 7009 — Law for Forensic Science**
- **FSCT 7010 — The Expert Witness: Prepared for Court**
- **FSCT 8156 — Instrumental Analysis for Forensic Chemistry**
- **FSCT 8160 — Forensic Biology: DNA Typing Applications**

**Year 4 – UBC**
You choose one of the stored Biochemistry pathways:

- **Path 1:** **BIOC 449 — UBC-BIOC-449 — Honours Thesis** plus 3 credits of advanced Biochemistry electives.
- **Path 2:** **BIOC 420 — UBC-BIOC-420 — Advanced Biochemical Techniques** plus 6 credits of advanced Biochemistry electives.

The advanced Biochemistry options include **BIOC 402 — UBC-BIOC-402 — Proteins: Structure and Function**, **BIOC 403 — UBC-BIOC-403 — Enzymology**, **BIOC 410 — UBC-BIOC-410 — Nucleic Acid: Structure and Function**, **BIOC 421 — UBC-BIOC-421 — Recombinant DNA Techniques**, **BIOC 430 — UBC-BIOC-430 — Advanced Topics in Protein Biochemistry**, **BIOC 440 — UBC-BIOC-440 — Concepts in Molecular Biology**, **BIOC 450 — UBC-BIOC-450 — Membrane Biochemistry**, **BIOC 460 — UBC-BIOC-460 — Advanced Techniques in Biochemistry**, and **BIOC 470 — UBC-BIOC-470 — Biochemistry and Society: Current Issues**.

Other Year 4 UBC options include **BIOL 301 — UBC-BIOL-301 — Biomathematics**, **BIOL 336 — UBC-BIOL-336 — Fundamentals of Evolutionary Biology**, **BIOL 462 — UBC-BIOL-462 — Ecological Plant Biochemistry**, **CPSC 330 — UBC-CPSC-330 — Applied Machine Learning**, **MEDG 421 — UBC-MEDG-421 — Genetics and Cell Biology of Cancer**, **MICB 405 — UBC-MICB-405 — Bioinformatics**, and **PCTH 325 — UBC-PCTH-325 — Rational Basis of Drug Therapy**.

### Admissions information
The stored program record includes:
- A UBC pathway with a minimum GPA of **76%**, changing to **70% for September 2026**, plus specified Chemistry, Communication, Biology, and calculus preparation.
- A transfer pathway requiring two terms of Chemistry with lab, and one term each of Biology, English, and differential calculus.
- A criminal record check as an entrance requirement.
- Optional co-op placement.

I’ll keep **Combined Honours in Biochemistry and Forensic Science** as our subject.

### Program overview
- **Credential:** Bachelor of Science  
- **Duration:** Four years  
- **Study mode:** Full-time  
- **Delivery:** In person  
- **Locations:** Burnaby Campus and UBC Vancouver  
- **Institutions:** Joint UBC/BCIT program  
- **Status:** Active  
- **Completion requirement:** 132 credits  

### Curriculum highlights

**Year 1 – UBC**
- Required: **BIOL 112 — Biology of the Cell**
- Required: **CHEM 123 — Principles of Chemistry 2**
- Required: **SCIE 113 — First-Year Seminar in Science**
- Chemistry alternative: **CHEM 121 — Principles of Chemistry**, **CHEM 111 — Principles of Chemistry**, or **CHEM 141 — Principles of Chemistry**, together with **CHEM 123 — Principles of Chemistry 2**
- Data science alternative: **DSCI 100 — Introduction to Data Science** or **CPSC 103 — Introduction to Systematic Program Design**
- Calculus alternative: **MATH 100 — Differential Calculus**, **MATH 102 — Differential Calculus**, or **MATH 104 — Differential Calculus**

**Year 2 – BCIT**
- **COMM 7200 — Report Writing and Workplace Communication for Forensic Investigation**
- **FSCT 7320 — Introduction to Forensic Science**
- **LIBS 7020 — Bioethics**

**Year 2 – UBC**
- Required: **BIOC 203 — Fundamentals of Biochemistry**
- **BIOL 200 — Fundamentals of Cell Biology**
- **BIOL 234 — Fundamentals of Genetics**
- **CHEM 203 — Introduction to Organic Chemistry**
- **CHEM 211 — Introduction to Chemical Analysis**
- **CHEM 213 — Organic Chemistry**
- **CHEM 245 — Intermediate Organic Chemistry Lab**
- Computing/statistics alternative: **STAT 201 — Statistical Inference for Data Science** or **CPSC 203 — Programming, Problem Solving, and Algorithms**

**Year 3 – BCIT**
- **FSCT 8150 — Forensic Biology: DNA Typing Theory**
- **FSCT 8155 — Forensic Biology: Evidence Recovery**
- **FSCT 8370 — Quality Assurance for Forensic Science**
- **FSCT 8371 — Business Management for Forensic Science**
- Elective pool includes **FSCT 7310 — Crime and Incident Scene Investigation**, **FSCT 7910 — Research Methodology and Measurement Models**, **FSCT 8230 — The Medicolegal Aspects of Alcohol**, **FSCT 8240 — Forensic Toxicology**, and **FSCT 8320 — The Science of Fingerprints - Theory**

**Year 3 – UBC**
- **BIOC 301 — Biochemistry Laboratory**
- **BIOC 303 — Molecular Biochemistry**
- **BIOL 335 — Molecular Genetics**

**Year 4 – BCIT**
- **FSCT 7009 — Law for Forensic Science**
- **FSCT 7010 — The Expert Witness: Prepared for Court**
- **FSCT 8156 — Instrumental Analysis for Forensic Chemistry**
- **FSCT 8160 — Forensic Biology: DNA Typing Applications**

**Year 4 – UBC**
You choose one of the stored Biochemistry pathways:

- **Path 1:** **BIOC 449 — Honours Thesis** plus 3 credits of advanced Biochemistry electives.
- **Path 2:** **BIOC 420 — Advanced Biochemical Techniques** plus 6 credits of advanced Biochemistry electives.

The advanced Biochemistry options include **BIOC 402 — Proteins: Structure and Function**, **BIOC 403 — Enzymology**, **BIOC 410 — Nucleic Acid: Structure and Function**, **BIOC 421 — Recombinant DNA Techniques**, **BIOC 430 — Advanced Topics in Protein Biochemistry**, **BIOC 440 — Concepts in Molecular Biology**, **BIOC 450 — Membrane Biochemistry**, **BIOC 460 — Advanced Techniques in Biochemistry**, and **BIOC 470 — Biochemistry and Society: Current Issues**.

Other Year 4 UBC options include **BIOL 301 — Biomathematics**, **BIOL 336 — Fundamentals of Evolutionary Biology**, **BIOL 462 — Ecological Plant Biochemistry**, **CPSC 330 — Applied Machine Learning**, **MEDG 421 — Genetics and Cell Biology of Cancer**, **MICB 405 — Bioinformatics**, and **PCTH 325 — Rational Basis of Drug Therapy**.

### Admissions information
The stored program record includes:
- A UBC pathway with a minimum GPA of **76%**, changing to **70% for September 2026**, plus specified Chemistry, Communication, Biology, and calculus preparation.
- A transfer pathway requiring two terms of Chemistry with lab, and one term each of Biology, English, and differential calculus.
- A criminal record check as an entrance requirement.
- Optional co-op placement.

The stored admissions record says applications are made through UBC Science/UBC Admissions, followed by an application for the specialization in June. Timing details for the criminal record check are not verified in the available data.

[Program information and source](https://www.bcit.ca/programs/combined-honours-in-biochemistry-and-forensic-science-bachelor-of-science-full-time-9940bsc/)
